title: Whose achievement is it?
lines: What happens to pride when excellent work no longer feels entirely your own?
Autopsy of Future Emotions explores the emotional side of living and working with AI.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Hold on a person beside work they have completed with assistance, with a small uncertain reaction.
voiceDirections: Speak with personal vulnerability; give gentle emphasis to entirely your own. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
Speak with warm clarity; give gentle emphasis to emotional side. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
